Positioned conveniently next to Five Ways train station, the property allows easy access to both Edgbaston/Selly Oak and City Centre university campuses. A short walk takes you to Birmingham's shopping, food, and nightlife. The recently developed Park Regis Hotel is close by.

This classic studio apartment is 19 square meters and fully furnished. It features a double bed with under-bed storage, a drawer unit, wardrobe, desk, chair, and a two-seater sofa. A flat-screen TV is mounted on the wall.

The kitchenette includes a microwave oven, a two-ring ceramic hob with extractor, and a full-sized fridge with a freezer compartment. One bedroom benefits from an en-suite shower room. There is a central laundry room on the ground floor.

This well-maintained property has been developed to a very high standard. Light and airy rooms create a pleasant living environment with views over Birmingham. A digital entry system and CCTV help tenants feel safe and secure.

Where bills are included: Gas, electricity, water, TV licence, fibre broadband where possible (limited by a fair usage policy).
